critical_code_review_comments: Minor: zip contains both SVG (icon16.svg, icon.svg) and PNG icon variants; manifest only references PNGs. SVGs are harmless but add ~1 KB dead weight — could be pruned from build step.

Not a real bug in production Chrome.
